13: apps/smart-files (thin egui frontend) → smart-ui-egui (shared components lib, rlib) → smart-protocol-rs (contract, features) → smart-core/backend_* shims (disposable)
14:                                                                                                       ↘ smart-lib optional (system services via IPC)
15: ```
16: * `smart-ui-egui` is a reusable lib. `apps/files|photos|terminal` are thin frontends on top (desktop `apps/` pattern). Never monolith.
17: * `smart-protocol-rs` is the only crate apps depend on. 89 schemas, feature-gated (`schema-files,mount,storage,archive,device,window,input`), `no_std+alloc`, no `capnp` binary needed.
18: * `smart-core` is the in-process implementation of protocol traits (monomorphized, zero-cost). File ops stay in-process for perf. No Cap'n Proto socket for `list/copy/search`.

20: * Old `smart-protocol` workspace (94 schemas incl. deleted `filesystem/surface/time`) is archived. Canonical source = `~/smart/smart-protocol-official/schema`. Rust = `~/smart/smart-protocol-rs`.

23: * All enter/exit/hover/press spring animations live **in `smart-ui-egui`** (`caret.rs`, `paint.rs`, `theme.rs`, new `anim.rs`) — single canonical source.

25: * `paint_hypnotic_caret`, breathing `0.65+0.35·sin(2πt/1.4)` + jump `spring_to(420/26)`, `reduce_motion` respected.

208: ### 3.2 Root causes — why “it opens but doesn’t paste”
209: 
210: Three independent bugs combine to produce the reported symptom. All must be fixed; fixing only the hover timer still leaves paste broken.
211: 
212: **Cause A — Tab-switch rewrites the drop target mid-gesture (frame-order race).** Hover 0.7 s queues `SwitchTab(i)` → drained *after* drag resolve that frame → next frame `tab_load(i)` calls `go()` which clears `sel/search`, reloads `entries` async, and re-renders tabs with **new `tab_i`/`self.route`**. On the release frame, `draw_tabs` now sees the hovered tab as **active** (`active=true`, `dropping=false`) and `DROP_TARGETS` carries `Place(self.route)` for the new active tab. If the user has *already passed* the 0.7 s dwell, they now drop onto the *active* tab strip — which is visually identical but the drag ghost/`tab_hover` progress is gone, and `content.rs`’s `Folder` targets under the pointer (now shifted by spring `tab_h`) can win due to `rev` order (`content` pushes after `sidebar` but before `tabs`; after switch the strip’s `r` moved). In practice users drop *during* the 0.7 s window: at release the queued `SwitchTab` has not yet been applied, but `drop_target_at(pos)` returns `Place(tabs[i].route)` for the *inactive* tab — correct dest — yet the *same frame* also queues `SwitchTab` (if dwell just crossed), so they see the tab open **and** expect paste into the just-opened view; instead the job was submitted to the *old* dest snapshot, then the view reloads and the pasted files are invisible until manual Refresh. The toast (`“Moving … to X”`) fires but the newly opened folder does not yet contain them (async `list()` in flight). **Fix must freeze dest at drop time, not post-switch route.**
213: 
214: **Cause B — Silent filter empties `srcs` with a misleading toast.** `Folder/Place` branch filters `s != dest && !dest.starts_with(s) && s.parent() != Some(&dest)`. Common case: user drags a subfolder onto the tab that *is its parent* (tabs are usually Home / Downloads / Documents = parents of most items). Then `s.parent()==dest` → `srcs` empty → `toast("That is already the destination", false)` in red. User reads as *failure* (“doesn’t paste”). It is technically a no-op for Move, but for **Copy** (Ctrl/Alt held) it *should* copy into parent under `name (1)`-style (or conflict dialog) — today both Move and Copy are killed identically. Same for cross-tab drag where source and dest fs differ but `dest.starts_with(s)` check on strings mis-fires for `/home/user` vs `/home/user2` without trailing-slash guard (code uses `starts_with` on `Location` which is correct, but `s.parent()` string equality is fragile for `/`).
215: 
216: **Cause C — No paste preview/conflict/progress/cancel wiring for tab drops.** `ops.rs:56-81` `unique_name()` *silently* renames collisions to `name (1).ext` (no Ask). `backend.rs:submit()` → `ops::run()` → `copy_tree()` with progress `Progress::bump` (coalesced 200/job) and `cancel` flag — correct — but the UI for tab drops shows only a toast (`“Moving …”`), no conflict preview (“2 will be renamed”), no byte total (only `measure()` sum, recursive `list()` which is expensive for dirs), no Jobs card cancel for the tab context (Jobs card exists in `overlays::draw_jobs_card` but not linked to drag), no “View in target” action. On cross-fs (`cross=true`) it forces Copy but never explains why. If `rename` fails cross-device, it falls through to `copy_tree` + `remove` — failure there surfaces only as `JobEvent::Failed` toast *after* the view already switched.
217: 
218: **Why “opens now” appeared fixed:** Adding the 0.7 s hover (`tab_hover`) made the target folder visible before drop, but because the drop still resolves to the *stale* `Place` snapshot *and* the subsequent `SwitchTab`+`load()` races the `list()` refresh, files land in the folder but the user is looking at a stale listing. The bug is not *no job* — it is *job submitted to wrong/frozen dest with no arrival guarantee + no conflict honesty*.
219: 
220: ### 3.3 Fix spec — paste preview, conflict, progress, cancel (must all ship)

222: **Freeze & split drop vs navigate (lib.rs + chrome.rs + app.rs):**

224: 1. **Never `SwitchTab` while `drag.is_some()` unless dwell is explicit and cancellable.** Keep 0.55 s dwell (eiga) but require `resp.hovered()` *and* pointer roughly still (±8 px) for the whole dwell. 176: ## 4. PHONE / MOUNT NEVER APPEARS — root cause + fix spec
177: 
178: ### 4.1 How devices are supposed to work
179: 
180: `Backend::new_native()` (native only, `backend.rs:102-124`) builds `providers = [SystemDevices]` + `[AdbDevices if adb_available()]` **once, at startup**. `assemble()` calls `p.list()` once, caches `Vec<Device>` in a `Mutex`, and (only at startup) auto-mounts every `adb:` device into the `Registry`. After that, the list only changes when something calls `refresh_devices()` (worker thread → `Event::Devices`).
181: 
182: ### 4.2 Why a connected phone never appears (ranked root causes — all silent)
183: 
184: 1. **No polling / no hotplug — the primary cause.** `refresh_devices()` is invoked only from: opening `Modal::Devices`/`Modal::Phone`, a `JobEvent::Finished`, a `DeviceOp` completion, and an explicit in-app "Mount a device" path (`app.rs:853,900,988,1157`). There is **no timer, no `notify` watcher on `/dev/bus/usb`, no `gio volume-mounted` subscription**. Plug in a phone after the app is running → sidebar (`chrome.rs:564-602`) never re-renders with it. The user sees "no phone" until they happen to open Devices. Combined with `devices()` being cached at startup, the phone appears to "never" mount.
185: 2. **ADB present-at-startup gate.** `adb_available()` runs `adb version` once. Phone added later, `adb` installed after launch, or `adb` started on-demand (`adb start-server` not yet run) → `AdbDevices` is **never in `providers`**, and `refresh_devices()` can never discover it. The fix must re-check availability on every poll, not at construction.
186: 3. **MTP phones are invisible by design.** `AdbDevices::query` filters `adb devices -l` lines for `" device "`. A stock Android in MTP/PTP mode (no USB debugging) emits **nothing** to `adb`. There is no GVfs/MTP provider (`gio mount mtp://…` is only reachable via the manual "Connect to server…" flow), so the most common phone connection shows nothing. The Devices modal footnote ("Phones connected over USB (MTP/ADB) show up … automatically", `modals.rs:845`) is **false for MTP**.
187: 4. **Silent filtering inside `query`/`list`.** States `unauthorized` (RSA prompt not accepted), `offline`, `authorizing`, `no permissions` are filtered out by `contains(" device ")` and never surfaced. Battery fetch (`adb -s … shell dumpsys battery | grep level`) is awaited per device inside `list()` and its errors are `.ok()`-discarded — a hung `adb` hangs the poll thread. `run("lsblk", …)` failure returns `vec![]` identically for "lsblk missing" and "no disks" (`devices.rs:107,357`).
188: 5. **Registry never evicted / unmount never unregisters.** `device_op("unmount")` lists devices but never calls `registry.remove(id)`. After eject, stale `adb:serial` entries remain listable → `Backend::list` returns `"no longer available"` only if the provider is gone, otherwise serves a dead `AdbVfs` that fails every `ls` with `Other(...)`.
189: 6. **WASM lie.** `devices::native` is `#[cfg(not(target_arch="wasm32"))]`; the web build gets zero providers. The Phone modal still says *"Plug in a phone and enable USB debugging (adb). It will appear here"* (`modals.rs:950`) — in the browser it never will. iPhones have no provider on any platform (no `ifuse`/`libimobiledevice` path) and are never named in the UI.
190: 7. **Parser fragility (`AdbVfs`)**: `parse()` assumes GNU `ls -lAL` columns and takes `line.find(time)+time.len()` as the filename start — breaks on toybox vs GNU, on filenames with spaces/newlines, on `…/Download` vs `…/DCIM`, on `ls` error text, and on `adb shell` quoting of `'` via `q()`. No timeout on `adb shell` — a disconnected phone blocks the thumbnail/search/job threads indefinitely.
191: 8. **macOS/Windows mount heuristics**: `mount()` returns `Err("Mounted — refreshing")` on macOS after a *successful* `diskutil mount` — UI toasts an error for success. Windows `unmount` always errors ("Use 'Safely remove hardware'"). `lsblk` `MOUNTPOINT` (singular) is empty on util-linux ≥2.37 (`MOUNTPOINTS`), so unmounted-but-present devices are missed and mounted phone MTP mounts (`/run/user/1000/gvfs/...`) are filtered by the `REAL_FS` allow-list anyway.
192: 
193: ### 4.3 Required mount pipeline (diagnostics, hotplug, honest limits)
194: 
195: ```
196: Poller (native only, 3 s) ──► AdbDevices::list + SystemDevices::list
197:       │                         (each with 5 s timeout, per-provider diagnostics)
198:       ▼
199:   Δ = new / disappeared / state-changed  →  Event::Devices(full list + diagnostics)
200:       │
201: UI: sidebar badges "phone · unauthorized — accept the RSA prompt on the device",
202:     "MTP detected via GVfs — mount via Locations", "adb not found — install android-sdk-platform-tools"
203: ```
204: 
205: Concrete changes:
206: 
207: - **Move provider discovery into the poller.** `refresh_devices()` must re-run `adb_available()` each tick and add/remove `AdbDevices` dynamically. Add `DeviceProvider::diagnostics() -> Option<String>` (adb path/server state, lsblk version, udisks availability).
208: - **Poll + hotplug.** Add a 3 s background thread (native) that calls `refresh_devices()` and compares snapshots; on insertion, auto-`mount()` the phone (`AdbVfs`) and emit `Event::Devices` + a non-error toast "Phone connected". Keep the existing modal-triggered refresh. Subscribe to `gio gio monitor` / `udisks` signals where available; on failure, polling alone must suffice.
209: - **States, not silence.** `AdbDevices::query` must parse `device / offline / unauthorized / no permissions / connecting` and surface all non-`device` states as `Device { mounted:false, detail:"Unauthorized — tap Allow on the phone" }`. Never drop a line silently.
210: - **MTP + iPhone honesty.** Add a GVfs probe (`gio mount -l` / `gio info mtp://…`) listed under Locations as `DeviceKind::Phone, detail:"MTP · via GVfs"` where present; otherwise the Phone modal must say *"MTP phones need GVfs (gio) or USB debugging. iPhones need libimobiledevice — not supported in this build."* and link to the platform docs. In wasm, the Phone modal must say *"Phone access needs the desktop app — the web preview cannot see USB devices."* (replacing the current "Plug in a phone" lie).
211: - **Timeouts + unregister.** Every `adb`/`gio`/`udisks` subprocess gets a 5 s kill-timeout (no indefinite thread block). `unmount`/`eject` must call `registry.remove()` and clear `device.loc`; `list()` after removal must return `NotFound`, not a stale VFS. Mount must return `Ok(Mounted)` (remove the "Mounted — refreshing" error hack; emit an explicit `Event::DeviceOp{result:Ok}` + `DeviceMounted` event instead).
212: - **Wiring smoke tests.** Integration test: start with no phone, spawn the poller, inject a fake `adb` script on `PATH` that first emits nothing then a `device` line, assert `Event::Devices` fires within 2 polls. Second test: `unauthorized` line → diagnostics contain "RSA".
213: 
214: Perf budget for the poller: ≤5 ms steady-state sidebar work, full `list()` on a background thread only, never on the UI thread (already the case — keep it that way and add the timer).

235: 
236: ```rust
237: // smart-core/src/thumb_service.rs (+ thumbs.rs becomes image-only backend)
238: pub struct ThumbRequest { pub loc: Location, pub edge: u32, pub want_meta: bool }
239: pub enum ThumbOutcome {
240:     Ready(ThumbResult),        // rgba in RAM (≤ 320 px edge)
241:     Meta(MediaMeta),           // ffprobe: duration, w×h, fps, codecs, chapters — no pixels
242:     Unsupported(String),       // e.g. "HEIC — install libheif", "AES ZIP", "wasm: no ffmpeg"
243: }

246: ```

248: Behaviour:
249: 
250: 1. **Dispatch by kind.** `Kind::Image` → existing `thumbs::decode` (image-crate). `Kind::Video` → **native**: `probe()` (ffprobe, 5 s timeout) → seek to `min(0.7 s, duration*0.1)` → single frame at `edge` (cap width at 384, height ≤ 216) → cache PNG. **wasm**: return `Unsupported("Video thumbnails need the desktop app (ffmpeg)")` — never a fake frame. `Kind::Audio` → ffprobe meta + embedded cover (`attached_pic` extraction) if present, else icon + duration. `Kind::Pdf` → no thumbnail (icon + page count if available) — never blank.
